description: This Perl script generates configuration snippets and metadata for embedded device targets based on provided target metadata. It parses a structured target metadata file and outputs configuration definitions suitable for build systems, handling features, profiles, subtargets, and device specifics.
external_methods: // inferred from usage in functions like gen_target_config() and gen_profile_mk()

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates build feature configuration strings based on input feature keywords, returning corresponding 'select' or 'depends on' directives for build configuration.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Constructs a target name string, combining parent and name if parent exists, otherwise returns the name.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings to a standardized format by replacing dots with underscores and trimming version components.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Outputs configuration blocks for a given target, including features, dependencies, and descriptive help text.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two lists of packages, avoiding duplicates and handling negations.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Reads target metadata from a specified file and generates comprehensive build configuration code for all targets and profiles.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefile entries for a specified target, including profile IDs, packages, and metadata.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to execute either configuration generation or profile makefile creation.
